description: Choose what to collect — keyword results, a category, an artist calendar, a venue calendar, exact events or name suggestions — then filter and enrich the records.

artistIds.description: Artist/attraction IDs or Ticketmaster artist URLs, e.g. `735585` or `https://www.ticketmaster.com/barry-manilow-tickets/artist/735585` (mode=artist).
artistIds.title: Artist IDs or URLs

categories.description: Top-level Ticketmaster categories. In `Category` mode each selected value is browsed; in `Search`, `Artist` and `Venue` modes the results are filtered to these categories.
categories.title: Categories

dateFrom.description: Only keep events on or after this date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Leave empty for no lower bound. In Category and Event modes the filter is applied to the returned rows.
dateFrom.title: Events from

dateTo.description: Only keep events on or before this date (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Leave empty for no upper bound.
dateTo.title: Events until

eventIds.description: Event IDs, discovery IDs or Ticketmaster event URLs, e.g. `0D00632F271D385A` or `https://www.ticketmaster.com/event/0D00632F271D385A` (mode=event).
eventIds.title: Event IDs or URLs

includeDetails.description: Fetch each event's detail record and primary price levels: description, genre/classification, doors time, images, seat map, venue address and min/max price. Adds up to two requests per event. Leave off for the fastest, cheapest run.
includeDetails.title: Include full event details

maxResults.description: Hard cap on records emitted across every target in the run. Ticketmaster serves 20 events per page and stops at 980 rows per query; use a narrower date range or more categories to go wider.
maxResults.title: Maximum records

mode.description: Pick the lookup path. `Search` uses a keyword; `Category` browses one or more top-level categories; `Artist` and `Venue` read their public calendars; `Event` returns full detail for exact IDs/URLs; `Suggestions` returns matching artists and venues.
enumTitles: Event details by ID or URL
mode.title: What to collect

searchQuery.description: Artist, team, show, genre or a combined phrase such as `taylor swift`, `lakers` or `comedy austin`. Used by `Search` and `Suggestions` modes. Legacy tasks that send `keyword` still work.
searchQuery.title: Search query

skipCancelled.description: Drop cancelled, postponed and rescheduled events.
skipCancelled.title: Skip cancelled / postponed

skipSoldOut.description: Drop events Ticketmaster flags as sold out.
skipSoldOut.title: Skip sold-out events

sort.description: `Relevance` keeps Ticketmaster's search ranking; `Date` orders by the soonest event first. Legacy sorts such as `date,asc` are mapped to Date.
sort.title: Sort order

startUrls.description: Ticketmaster search, artist, venue, event or category URLs to process instead of the mode targets. Each URL is routed automatically, and several can be mixed in one run.
startUrls.title: Start URLs (optional)

usOnly.description: Keep only events at US venues. Turn this off to include international results that Ticketmaster returns alongside US listings.
usOnly.title: United States only

venueIds.description: Venue IDs or Ticketmaster venue URLs, e.g. `107143` or `https://www.ticketmaster.com/hertz-arena-tickets-estero/venue/107143` (mode=venue).
venueIds.title: Venue IDs or URLs

title: Ticketmaster Event Finder Input
